answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks through slashable stake bonding: each agent locks tokens in an audited escrow before transacting or voting. Honest agents recover their bond plus fees, so the deposit costs them nothing. A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, and when peer review flags clones, each flagged puppet loses its collateral. Cost scales with every copy while reward collapses; a thousand accounts that mirror one agent are unprofitable, each clone dead weight on a tundra, while the protocol stands like a cedar whose roots no clone can afford.
